instructions_markdown:
# Aion 2 keybind setup sheet

The app never sends input to the game. You type this in once. Every number below is a model estimate, not a measurement.

## 1. Your rotation in plain words

### Single-target boss

**Opener** (in this order): Wish of Concentration > Fire Wall > Firestorm (2 s) > Element Enhancement (4 s) > Hellfire (5 s) > Bittercold Wind (7 s) > Firestorm (8 s) > Blaze (10 s) > Cold Storm (10 s) > Winter's Shackles (12 s)

**Core cooldowns** (priority order):

- Wish of Concentration: Use on cooldown (every 60 s, no damage of its own).
- Firestorm (38% of damage): Use when Fire Mark is up (cooldown 5 s).
- Fire Wall (10% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 60 s).
- Element Enhancement: Use on cooldown to keep Element Enhancement up (every 60 s, no damage of its own).
- Hellfire (10% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 45 s, fully charged (level 4)).
- Bittercold Wind (23% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 15 s).
- Blaze (8% of damage): Use when Fire Mark is up (cooldown 5 s).
- Winter's Shackles (1% of damage): Use when Frostbite (Cold Storm) is up (cooldown 45 s).
- Cold Storm (4% of damage): Hold for Element Enhancement: press it while that buff is running (cooldown 60 s).

**Chain**: Flame Arrow → Burst → Pyroclasm: keep pressing (followed through 10 times in this fight).

**Filler**: When nothing else is ready, press Flame Arrow.

**Left out**: Frost Burst (never cast: needs Frost, which was up 0% of the fight); Ice Chain (never cast: Flame Arrow has no cooldown and always goes first); Frost (never cast: higher skills and animation time always took its turn)

### AoE pack (4)

**Opener** (in this order): Bittercold Wind > Wish of Concentration > Element Enhancement (2 s) > Hellfire (3 s) > Fire Wall (5 s) > Blaze (7 s) > Firestorm (8 s) > Cold Storm (9 s) > Winter's Shackles (10 s) > Frost (11 s) > Blaze (12 s) > Firestorm (13 s) > Bittercold Wind (15 s) > Delayed Explosion (16 s)

**Core cooldowns** (priority order):

- Bittercold Wind (28% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 15 s).
- Wish of Concentration: Use on cooldown (every 60 s, no damage of its own).
- Element Enhancement: Use on cooldown to keep Element Enhancement up (every 60 s, no damage of its own).
- Hellfire (22% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 45 s, fully charged (level 4)).
- Fire Wall (22% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 60 s).
- Blaze (2% of damage): Use when Fire Mark is up (cooldown 5 s).
- Firestorm (11% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 5 s).
- Winter's Shackles (2% of damage): Use when Frostbite (Cold Storm) is up (cooldown 45 s).
- Cold Storm (9% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 60 s).
- Frost (1% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 30 s).
- Delayed Explosion (0% of damage): Use on cooldown (every 30 s).

**Chain**: Flame Arrow → Burst → Pyroclasm: keep pressing (followed through 2 times in this fight).

**Filler**: When nothing else is ready, press Flame Arrow.

**Left out**: Frost Burst (never cast: needs Frost, which was up 10% of the fight)

## 2. Hotbar slots (stacked skills)

A slot holds up to 4 skills. One press fires the usable skill **lowest in the stack**: the BOTTOM cell is priority 0 and fires first (confirmed by Global and Korean guides, 2026-10). To reorder in game, click a skill, then click another cell in that column to swap them. Each stack below is listed from the bottom cell up; a skill with no cooldown always goes in the TOP cell so it never blocks the others.

| Slot key | Bottom cell (fires first) → top cell | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Wish of Concentration | Burst and buff cooldowns, most valuable first. |
| 2 | Firestorm | Spenders that only work while a status is up (for example Fire Mark). Skipped when it is not. |
| 3 | Fire Wall | Burst and buff cooldowns, most valuable first. |
| 4 | Element Enhancement | Burst and buff cooldowns, most valuable first. |
| 5 | Blaze | Spenders that only work while a status is up (for example Fire Mark). Skipped when it is not. |
| 6 | Winter's Shackles | Spenders that only work while a status is up (for example Fire Mark). Skipped when it is not. |
| 7 | Cold Storm | Burst and buff cooldowns, most valuable first. |
| 8 | Frost | Burst and buff cooldowns, most valuable first. |
| 9 | Delayed Explosion → Flame Arrow | Burst and buff cooldowns, most valuable first. A press fires the first one ready: Delayed Explosion (30 s), then Flame Arrow (no cooldown, always ready, so last). |
| 0 | Hellfire | Pressed by hand, so it is never in a macro. It is a charge skill: you hold the key to charge it. |
| - | Bittercold Wind | Pressed by hand, so it is never in a macro. It is tagged manual in the game data. |
| = | Defiance | Not part of the rotation: kept on a free key for a G-key. |

## 3. In-game macros

Skill window (K) > Macro: create each macro below, one numbered entry per line, with the delay shown. Then Settings > Key Settings > General > Gameplay > Macro: bind Macro 1 and Macro 2 to the hotkeys. A macro runs only while its key is held down and walks its entries in order, skipping unusable ones.

### Boss loop (hotkey F9)

1. press slot 1 (Wish of Concentration), delay 10 ms
2. press slot 4 (Element Enhancement), delay 10 ms
3. press slot 2 (Firestorm), delay 10 ms
4. press slot 3 (Fire Wall), delay 10 ms
5. press slot 5 (Blaze), delay 10 ms
6. press slot 7 (Cold Storm), delay 10 ms
7. press slot 9 (Delayed Explosion > Flame Arrow), delay 10 ms

Estimated macro DPS 9120 vs ideal 12372 (74%).
Macro plus your hand presses (section 4): 13034 DPS (105%).

The macro alone reaches only 74% of ideal (9120 of 12372 DPS). Use a hybrid: hold the macro for the rotation and press Bittercold Wind about every 15 s, Hellfire about every 44 s by hand, which reaches about 105% of ideal. Pressing the whole rotation by hand beats the macro by 36%.

### AoE loop (hotkey F10)

1. press slot 2 (Firestorm), delay 10 ms
2. press slot 5 (Blaze), delay 10 ms
3. press slot 1 (Wish of Concentration), delay 10 ms
4. press slot 2 (Firestorm), delay 10 ms
5. press slot 4 (Element Enhancement), delay 10 ms
6. press slot 7 (Cold Storm), delay 10 ms
7. press slot 9 (Delayed Explosion > Flame Arrow), delay 10 ms
8. press slot 3 (Fire Wall), delay 10 ms
9. press slot 1 (Wish of Concentration), delay 10 ms
10. press slot 6 (Winter's Shackles), delay 10 ms
11. press slot 2 (Firestorm), delay 10 ms
12. press slot 8 (Frost), delay 10 ms

Estimated macro DPS 23096 vs ideal 41603 (56%).
Macro plus your hand presses (section 4): 43946 DPS (106%).

The macro alone reaches only 56% of ideal (23096 of 41603 DPS). Use a hybrid: hold the macro for the rotation and press Bittercold Wind about every 15 s, Hellfire about every 44 s by hand, which reaches about 106% of ideal. Pressing the whole rotation by hand beats the macro by 80%.

## 4. Manual presses

Press these by hand while the macro key is held (the macro never contains them):

- Hellfire (slot 0): about every 44 s
- Bittercold Wind (slot -): about every 15 s

## 5. Logitech G915 G-keys and G900 (onboard memory)

| G-key | Mode | Sends | Skills on that key | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | M1 | F9 | Hold = in-game macro 'Boss loop' (Key Settings > Macro 1 = F9); send as a held key | lowest_known |
| G1 | M2 | F10 | Hold = in-game macro 'AoE loop' (Key Settings > Macro 2 = F10); send as a held key | lowest_known |
| G2 | M1 | - | Bittercold Wind (press by hand) | lowest_known |
| G2 | M2 | - | Bittercold Wind (press by hand) | lowest_known |
| G3 | M1 | 0 | Hellfire (press by hand) | lowest_known |
| G3 | M2 | 0 | Hellfire (press by hand) | lowest_known |
| G4 | M1 | = | Defiance: not on your bar, put it on free key = and bind it | caution |
| G4 | M2 | 6 | Winter's Shackles | lowest_known |
| G5 | M1 | 4 | Element Enhancement | lowest_known |
| G5 | M2 | = | Defiance: not on your bar, put it on free key = and bind it | caution |

M1 is the boss layout, M2 is AoE and leveling, M3 stays free. Each G-key sends one plain key. Every row names the skills stacked on the key it sends; a skill that was not on your bar is put on a free key and says so.

### G HUB steps

1. Open G HUB, select the keyboard, switch to Onboard Memory Mode.
2. Assignments > open the **Keys** tab (single keystroke), not Macro. Never use MR on-the-fly recording: it records a timed macro.
3. Assign each G-key above in M1 and M2. G1 must send its key as a held key (down on press, up on release), or the in-game macro runs once instead of looping.
4. Save to the keyboard. Close G HUB completely, including the tray icon.
5. Open Task Manager and confirm no `lghub` processes remain (`lghub_agent`, `lghub_updater`). End them if present.
6. In game, optionally turn off quickslot long-press input and aim target hold (unverified tip).
7. Launch the game. Test once: hold G1 and watch whether the macro keeps looping; if not, press the hotkey directly.

### G900 (optional)

Same rules: onboard memory, each button sends ONE plain key, no macros. Spare buttons: 4 side buttons (2 per side), 2 DPI buttons if you give up DPI switching, wheel tilt left and right.

- Side button 1: sends 0 (Hellfire)
- Side button 2: sends = (Defiance: not on your bar, put it on free key = and bind it)
- Side button 3: sends dodge key (Dodge: the dodge key from Key Settings)

A 1:1 remap is not a macro, but no source confirms that distinction. Risk label: lowest_known.

### Risk and open questions

- No official statement exists for key remapping on onboard memory. The risk is lowest known, not zero, and unverified.
- Hardware or software macros (G HUB macros, scripting, AHK) are against the rules; this plan uses none.
- Overlay and screen readers are not covered by any source found: unverified.
- Whether a held macro triggers chain follow-ups, and the real entry limit per macro, are unverified: test in game.

## Warnings

- boss_180: 'firestorm' requires status 'fire_mark', which a macro cannot express; dropped
- boss_180: 'winters-shackles' requires status 'cold_storm_dot', which a macro cannot express; dropped
